answer: Sybil resistance works when each identity must sink a scarce, non-copyable stake to exist. Picture an orchard: planting one tree costs real soil, water, and years before it bears fruit. An attacker spinning up a thousand fake agents is like scattering seeds across a barren dune, nothing takes root. Bond each agent with staked collateral plus a slowly earned reputation, and the honest garden of agents thrives while cheap clones wither, because forging many identities now costs more than any single fraudulent payout returns.
